correctness.rationale: The source defines adjacency as all three coordinates unequal and a 2304-element coordinate group, not necessarily the full abstract graph automorphism group. Antolín Camarena–Carnero Bravo Proposition 25 proves that its independence complex is a wedge of 63 three-spheres. The signed Lefschetz sum over invariant independent faces equals independent-set polynomial at -1 of the vertex-orbit conflict graph. A separate newly implemented quotient-orbit recursion recomputed all 40 two-parity coordinate conjugacy-type traces, including identity 63 and layer flip 9, matching each source table row. Standard S4 wreath-C2 character inner products give exactly 8 distinct rational irreducibles of dimensions 1,6,4,9,12,18,4,9, layer ± dimensions 36/27 and no full invariants. The finite proof uses the cited nonequivariant homotopy theorem for degree concentration; 40 representative computations alone are not a proof of it.
residual_risks: The nonequivariant homotopy assertion is published and not new.
